Uh? What are you? Human... Plus, you're alive.\nNot a soul. How did you stray into here?\n...Oh, Grecia sent you.
So, where are you headed?\n...Whaaat? You go save Dunkelis?!
Even if you owe your life to Grecia, that's\nimpossible for humans, you know?!
Wait. Since Grecia saved the human's life, this\nhuman must be capable of something.\nLet's ask what has happened...
Sorry for not introducing myself first.\nI'm Bugna. I'm a guard of this castle and serving\nDunkelis.
I'm Eches. An excellent knight of darkness...
Excellent knight, huh? Don't make me laugh...\nWell, it doesn't matter.
We need to leave the castle to go save Dunkelis,\nhowever, we are under attack of the mutant\nsoldiers, so we cannot leave here...
We need to guard Grecia as well, so you need to\ngo alone... Is that alright?
Ha ha! You've got guts!\nI like it.
I'll throw you to the place Dunkelis is so you\ncan avoid the enemies. Are you ready?\n3, 2, 1...!
H-Hold on, Eches!!\nThe direction is...
You idiot!\nThat's not the direction to Soldier's Cradle!!
Oh? That was wrong?\nOhh... What should I do, Bugna?
There's nothing we can do.\nThe human has flown away.
The human won Grecia's confidence.\nAll we can do is to trust...
Whoa?! You are... Oh, I remember.\nIt's the human who went to save Dunkelis...!
What? I threw you to a wrong direction?\nSorry. I noticed it after that.
But, I'm glad that you seem alright...\nOh, you're irresponsible, you say?\nSo, I'm saying I'm sorry.
So, what about Dunkelis?\nYou saved her?!
No worries. Not only rescuing Dunkelis, this\nadventurer regained control of the Dark Manor,\nand saved me from enemy's hand.
W-What?! The Dark Manor was full of enemies!\nYou took back control?!
Hmm... Now I understand why Grecia saved you.\nYou're not an ordinary human.
I got a report that Grecia was missing.\nWhat's the situation now?
Um, it's...
The castle is occupied by the enemies and we can't\neven get in there.
We have no idea where Grecia is now.
Okay. The adventurer and I will save Grecia.\nYou guys stay here.
No! We'll go with you.
Hydra will bring reinforcements later.\nI want you guys to destroy the enemies with them\nand liberate the castle.
I understood! Then, leave it to us!!
We'll liberate the castle for sure while you're\nrescuing Grecia!!
Alright! I'm counting on you!!
The enemies must be nesting the central part\nof the castle like the Dark Manor...\nNow let's go to the hall!
Oh, wait for me!
Cannot go to another map during the battle!
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Memecoleous!!
